findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_meeting_link, get_holidays · Private data: find_best_meeting_time, create_meeting_link, get_holidays · Public sink: create_meeting_link, dst_check, submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_meeting_link, get_holidays · Private data: find_best_meeting_time, create_meeting_link, get_holidays · Public sink: create_meeting_link, dst_check, submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
